metadata.description: Verify no LOOP pool already includes spatial coherence as a signal member

finding.detail: Spatial coherence is a MODULATOR, not a signal. It modifies existing signal confidences based on regional agreement. It does not produce independent predictions and is not registered as a signal member of any pool.
evidence: POOL_DEFINITIONS in core/signal_families.py (line 578): 11 pools (gefs, ecmwf, climatology, eighty_two_member, nwp_direct, metar, pressure, generalist, reversion, momentum, nwp_upper) — none include spatial coherence
SpatialCoherenceGate in core/spatial_coherence.py: implements modulate_confidence(), not evaluate() — it is a modulator, not a signal
PoolOfPools.evaluate() in core/signal_fusion.py (line 155): spatial_coherence is received as a key in the modulators dict, not in signal_predictions
signal_fusion.py line 420: spatial coherence modulation is applied as an n_eff multiplier, not as a pool posterior
Track B (core/pool_architectures/track_b.py line 474-480): spatial coherence is applied as modulator at the track level
finding.recommendation: No action needed. Spatial coherence is correctly implemented as a fusion-stage modulator. Adding it as a pool member would create circular dependency (spatial coherence needs pool outputs to compute agreement).
